Meet-and-confer talking points (concise script): thank them for meeting; state we share the goal of efficient, cooperative discovery and are proposing the above protocol to meet their substance while minimizing business disruption; offer transparency (hit counts) and phased rolling production (priority: delivery communications and non-privileged loss analyses), produce representative internal analyses rather than every draft, and ask they reciprocally narrow any duplicative “all communications” requests; propose reconvening after hit-counts to refine searches if needed.  
Confirming-letter language to send after call: “Thanks for today’s call. Per our discussion, we will run the agreed searches for [custodians] over the date range [six months before first missed-delivery to three months after last missed-delivery] using the agreed keyword set, will provide hit counts by [date], will begin rolling production of priority categories by [date] and will deliver a privilege log within [14] days of each production; we agreed to reconvene on [date] to assess results and further narrow any overbroad queries. Each party reserves all rights.”
